scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && set -a && . ./deploy.env && set +a && pnpm --filter web exec cf d1 migrations apply "$TASKSHQ_D1_ID" --dir ./drizzle

scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:web && pnpm run deploy:mcp
